items.title: Big Tech's equally big debt pile is raising concerns about the AI boom
items.summary: The total capital raised by AI hyperscaler, data center, and neo-cloud companies from high-grade debt sales has doubled from $172 billion in 2025 to $346 billion in 2026 year-to-date, according to Barclays strategist Venu Krishna. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi reacts to Krishna's findings and what it means for the AI ecosystem, especially as major companies prepare to go public.

items.title: AI in America has a huge 1.7 million job shortage problem

items.summary: President Trump met with several AI leaders at the White House on Tuesday, including Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang and Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) CEO Dario Amodei. Yahoo Finance Washington Correspondent Ben Werschkul outlines the details.

items.title: Needham names top SaaS picks amid Meta Enterprise Platform concerns
items.summary: Investing.com -- Needham analyst Scott Berg identified three software stocks as top picks following a recent market selloff triggered by Meta's Enterprise Platform announcement, noting that the new offering does not directly compete with enterprise software vendors in his coverage universe.

items.title: MongoDB Stock Regains Ground. How Investor Day Addressed CEO Leaving For Meta.
items.summary: MongoDB stock regained some ground Wednesday after news its CEO was leaving for a job at Meta Platforms caused a sell-off.

items.title: What Could Derail AppLovin Stock?
items.summary: AppLovin (APP) holders have been through a rough stretch. The shares lost 54% over the past year, while the S&P 500 gained 16.8%. A $10,000 holding from a year ago is now worth about $4,560. In September, law firms began announcing a securities class action over what AppLovin told investors. For you, the bigger issue is a business problem, not the legal fight. So what is the biggest risk for AppLovin stock from here.
